body:
Real, checked-live finding: these were the two genuinely un-tuned characters, not literally 'the same move' but the closer-to-true read once fixed (neither had a dedicated special at all). Sunlit Draw: Bracing Stance (up-B, defense) + Sunbreak Slam (down-B, harder-hitting directional damage). Sequel Duck: Bow Toss (down-B, flat/fast) + Hat Trick (up-B, tall lob), both real projectile throws from her own compendium descriptor, reusing the Turnip pipeline via new style sentinels above CHARACTER_COUNT. 4 new tests, 16/16 total pass. Commit caee548. README updated.

⚓ ☃
title: BPTUNE-10001 shipped: distinct up-B/down-B for Sunlit Draw + Sequel Duck
